- With agent teams on, a named spawn becomes a teammate in the lead's working directory. The [agent-team docs (line 277)](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams.md#L277) give an in-process teammate its definition's effort; the [2.1.288 changelog (line 365)](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/fbe20e00e2851fc01506f54f98a8f0b875af3847/CHANGELOG.md#L365) confirms this specifically for plugin-defined agents. The lead and project definitions here both specify `max`, so either path selects the same configured effort; runtime effort for user/project definitions remains unverified. Definition `skills` and `isolation` do not apply: name spawns only for teammates, never for a role that relies on `skills`, `omitClaudeMd` or `isolation`, and start a run that needs them with `claude --settings '{"env":{"CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS":"0"}}'`.
